entities.summary: Viktor Prokhorovich Yakushev was an ice hockey player who played in the Soviet Hockey League. He played for Lokomotiv Moscow. He was inducted into the Russian and Soviet Hockey Hall of Fame in 1963. He was born and died in Moscow.
